caption: If the Sun switched off right now, you wouldn't notice for 8 minutes and 20 seconds, because that's how long its light takes to reach Earth. Then the sky would go black and the Moon would vanish too, since moonlight is just reflected sunlight. Earth would stop orbiting and drift off into space in a straight line. Within a week the average surface temperature would fall below about -18°C, and within a year to around -73°C. The ocean surface would freeze, but that ice would insulate the water beneath it, keeping the deep ocean liquid for a very long time. Down there, microbes around hydrothermal vents that run on chemical energy instead of sunlight could keep going. Would YOU survive the dark? 👇
